content.value_statement: AltLLM Portal tasks can span authentication, keys, billing, and payments. This skill routes each request to the correct focused workflow.
actual_capabilities: Routes Portal requests to focused authentication, API key, billing, payment, or x402 skills.
Distinguishes Portal administration from OpenAI-compatible gateway inference.
Maps supported CLI commands to their responsible skills and repository files.
Coordinates workflows that cross login, key creation, billing review, and payment operations.
Explains personal and Flex tiers, model access metadata, and API key allowlists.
limitations: Does not implement the AltLLM CLI or Portal API.
Depends on focused sibling skills and shared repository guidance.
Does not document or proxy gateway inference requests.
Provides x402 guidance because the current CLI has no x402 commands.

use_cases.title: Navigate Portal Commands
use_cases.description: Identify the focused skill and repository area for a Portal CLI task.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Account Workflows
use_cases.description: Connect authentication, session, billing, and usage steps during support investigations.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Payment Operations
use_cases.description: Plan crypto top-ups, payment checks, x402 settlement, and balance verification.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Focused Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the correct AltLLM Portal skill for this task: [task]. List the relevant commands.

prompt_templates.title: Review Plan Access
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how to inspect my Portal tier and model access for this account: [account context].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Step Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Portal workflow from wallet login through API key creation and gateway verification for [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Payment Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this top-up or x402 flow: [details]. Separate payment, settlement, and balance verification steps.

output_examples.input: Which skill handles API key revocation?
output_examples.output: Use the AltLLM Portal API keys skill. It covers listing, inspecting, updating, and revoking Portal-issued gateway keys.

output_examples.input: Plan a workflow to review recent model usage.
output: Confirm the active Portal session and target.
Inspect usage summaries, timelines, models, or keys.
Compare the results with transaction history.

output_examples.input: Can the current CLI perform an x402 top-up?
output_examples.output: The current CLI has no x402 commands. Use the x402 guidance skill for quotes, wallet signing, settlement, cancellation, and balance verification.

best_practices: Read the shared preflight and session guidance before the first CLI command.
Use a focused skill when the request stays within one Portal domain.
Confirm the active account and target before changing keys or payments.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to document or proxy gateway inference.
Do not assume x402 commands exist in the current AltLLM CLI.
Do not use the umbrella workflow when one focused skill covers the request.

faq.question: When should I use this umbrella skill?
faq.answer: Use it when a task crosses multiple Portal domains or when the correct focused skill is unclear.

faq.question: Does this skill run the AltLLM CLI?
faq.answer: It provides routing and workflow guidance. The local CLI and focused skills perform the specific operations.

faq.question: Does it cover model inference?
faq.answer: No. It covers Portal administration, not OpenAI-compatible gateway requests.

faq.question: Which API keys does it manage?
faq.answer: It routes management of Portal-issued keys used with the OpenAI-compatible gateway.

faq.question: Does the CLI support x402 commands?
faq.answer: No. The current CLI uses a separate skill for x402 quote, signing, settlement, cancellation, and verification guidance.

faq.question: Can it help with Flex plans?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains returned Flex metadata and routes model allowlist tasks to the API key skill.
